title: Routing config migration assistant and user-friendly schema errors
creator: Asha Nair
description: Problem: Existing routing DSL schema validator emits opaque errors that are hard for PMs and SREs to act on during large migrations. We frequently see users blocked by subtle breaking changes (region field shape, tier semantics, fallback model variant names) and engineers spending cycles explaining fix steps. Goal: build a migration assistant and redesign validation error surface so that operators get actionable, machine-readable guidance and an automated dry-run migration CLI. This ticket scopes the validator UX, dry-run migration assistant, and the server-side telemetry hooks needed for incremental rollout. Deliverables: 1) server-side staged-schema-checker that supports 'error levels' (error/warning/suggestion), 2) human-friendly error messages with example patches and line references, 3) a dry-run CLI that suggests fixes and can apply opt-in autofixes, and 4) telemetry events for migration success/failure and common error patterns.
acceptance_criteria: New validator runs as a lightweight pre-apply hook and classifies findings into error/warning/suggestion
Errors include an explanation, exact DSL fragment, suggested replacement, and minimal example patch
CLI dry-run produces a markdown report and an opt-in --apply-autofix that rewrites compatible patterns
Server returns validation diagnostics in the Linear API and Console with links to the suggested patch PR template
Telemetry events emitted for >=90% of pipeline runs: validation_start, validation_findings, autofix_applied
Backward-compatible: existing routing controller accepts current schema unless 'strict_validation=true' is enabled for canary customers
technical_notes: Design: multilayered validator with 1) syntactic linter, 2) semantic rule checker, 3) heuristics for fuzzy variant matching
We will base the DSL parser on existing Route AST code (reuse parser modules from ENG-314159) and implement staged adapters for legacy keys
Autofix policy: only apply deterministic transforms (rename field, move nested keys, expand shorthand) in --apply-autofix; otherwise produce suggestion
Trade-offs: aggressive autofix reduces manual review but risks misconfiguring intent. Default to suggestion and require flag to mutate live configs.
Performance: validator must validate 500 small route files in <3s for CI. We'll implement incremental cache and memoized schema checks to meet SLO.
Security: validator will not execute arbitrary code; sandboxed evaluation for template expansions is required. Security review flagged (see dependencies).
tasks: Spec: write user-facing error taxonomy and example messages
Parser: extract stable AST surface and export location mapping (line/col) for diagnostics
Validator: implement staged adapters for 3 major breaking changes we observed in the field
CLI: implement routing-migrate --dry-run and --apply-autofix with markdown output
Console integration: expose diagnostics on per-config pages and attach suggested patch link
Telemetry: define events, wire to validator, and add instrumentation for aggregated dashboard
Docs: create migration playbook and example PR templates for customer success
